title: Meeting, Farewell
overview: Nos últimos dias de vida do pai, um filho encontra no hospital a chance de viver a intimidade que os dois passaram anos adiando. [PT] During his father’s final days, a son discovers in a hospital the chance to share the closeness they had spent a lifetime avoiding. [EN]  En los últimos días de vida de su padre, un hijo encuentra en el hospital la oportunidad de vivir la intimidad que ambos pasaron años postergando. [ES]

title: Thera: The Inverted Planet
overview: On another world much like our own, a young Samoyed named Seamus Alessandro O'Shaughnessy discovers a lost girl named Dakota who has unfathomable magic! Seamus must overcome great challenges both physical & emotional alongside his best friend Carolina Oriqueda Campbell Keeshond-Seal to save Great Canyon City from the Menace known as The Blurred Blaze! Can our heroes defeat their foes while simultaneously protecting an innocent child in the process? And who exactly is The Blurred Blaze?

title: Dave the film maker
overview: Dave is an amateur film maker who little bit too much of a Nolan and Tarantino fan. When his start making his first movie with friend and family, his flaws start to destroy his relationship and his film to being any good.

title: The Break
overview: After five years of dating, a couple decides to take a break from each other, choosing that their only interaction until their emotions settle down to take place once every month. However, as time goes on and the more time they spend apart, the more they themselves begin to change.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
overview: Sonic the Hedgehog, joined by a new hero named Amy, faces a new technological nemesis known as Metal Sonic.

title: After Hours
overview: Two brothers trapped in poverty gamble on day trading as ambition turns to addiction. When one final all-in bet collapses, their home becomes a pressure cooker where love, pride, and survival collide.

title: A Kind of Polygamy
overview: When Harsha encounters the strange events unfolding around him, he is made to realise that the deeper he digs, the darker his truth becomes.

title: Vāranāsi
overview: Follows Rudhra's perilous adventures as ancient Varanasi stands on the brink of catastrophe from a looming asteroid in 2027 CE, unfolding across multiple timelines and distant continents.

title: H24
overview: To avoid going to prison, Mélanie—an impulsive, outspoken young woman—is forced to train as a nursing assistant. The problem is, she faints at the slightest needle prick or drop of blood. After yet another blunder, she has no choice but to accept a job that’s completely unsuitable for her: providing round-the-clock care for a 65-year-old obsessive businessman who has just survived a stroke and can’t stand anyone invading his personal space. With these two together, their living arrangement promises to be explosive…

title: Wings of Freedom
overview: Home-loving eagle Salana is forced out of her jungle bird colony to join Pirro, an intrepid swift and member of the Animal Air Force. This unlikely duo embarks on an epic, high-flying adventure to stop a malevolent AI and save the world.

title: Vanshika Randi :- Kathamipura Story
overview: The story is based in india small city Panipat Hub where a girl name Vanshika lives due to hardship of life she ended up becoming a sex worker this movie portrays how hardships can lead to unwanted decisions in life the movie is inspired from real life events and india unknown streets where such work has become very common the story evolves around how vanshika who's now labelled as "Randi" By society will overcome this and achieve a normal life again.

title: Marta
overview: Based on the true-life events of six-time FIFA World Player of the Year, Marta Vieira da Silva, widely regarded as the greatest female football player of all time.

title: Dudley & the Invasion of the Space Slugs
overview: Dudley is a teenage frog who lives a peaceful life by the edge of his pond with his friends, meanwhile his parents are worried about his future. But when aliens land on Earth, Dudley's world is thrown into chaos. What if he has what it takes to become a hero and save the whole of humanity?

title: Seagull
overview: Biopic focusing on Valentina Tereshkova

title: Get Lite
overview: Saunders, a headstrong Bronx teenager, is caught between his love of Litefeet subway dancing and his strict's insistence on becoming an engineer.

title: Boys for Life
overview: Plot TBA; an ensemble comedy about a group of friends reuniting — with a twist.

title: PSA: Missing Persons
overview: This is a PSA for all those who think hitchhiking is a good idea...

title: Up Against It
overview: Álvaro and his ex-wife Saffron attempt to set aside the drama of their messy divorce for the sake of their daughter Rose.

title: Sidi Kaba and the Gateway Home
overview: With the help of the goddess Mami Wata, Sidi Kaba, an 8‑year-old boy, tries to find his brother who has been taken prisoner by slave traders. A fantastic epic that delivers us along the road of slavery.

title: Veselchak U
overview: The space pirate Veselchak U got stuck on Earth in our time after a run-in with Alice Selezneva, her mother, and high school students from a Moscow school. More than anything, he wants to take over Cosmion, return to his own time, and finally lead the Pirate Alliance. His search for the artifact leads him to the boy Yura and his mother Katya, who are mysteriously connected to Cosmion. And when the powerful space warrior Theo starts hunting for them, the Merry Man has to stand up for Yura and Katya — after all, he is a noble pirate. Together they embark on a journey full of dangerous adventures to uncover all the secrets of their past and future.

title: Ramon's Revenge
overview: A young boy stumbles across a deserted stash of cocaine.

title: The 08' Club
overview: Dick Negroni begins as a composed bartender at the '08 Club who trades his mixing tins for a life of crime after catching the eye of the powerful mob boss Don Gog. Alongside his volatile partners, Dick must navigate a treacherous path of betrayal and escalating madness where the line between professional "cleanup" and total lunacy begins to blur.

title: Spaceballs: The New One
overview: Forty years after the events of the first Spaceballs, the galaxy is once again under threat. A threat so evil, so unstoppable, so completely lacking in any original ideas, that it has vowed to bring back the past... every last bit of it. With Lone Starr in hiding, Queen Vespa on the throne, and the Schwartz stretched thinner than a franchise releasing TV episodes theatrically, the only hope for the galaxy is Vespa's undisciplined son, Prince Starburst, and a mysterious Palace advisor named Destiny. Together, they must find Lone Starr, Yogurt, and any other iconic legacy characters fans are demanding before they discover the hard way that, while some threats you can fight, the reboot is not one of them.

title: A Place in Hell
overview: A top criminal defense attorney, known for representing unlikeable clients in high-profile cases, is a relentless workhorse at her firm and fully expects to be named partner. When another attorney joins the firm, her job is put to the test and makes her question just how far she’ll go to protect it.

title: Comoara lui Harap-Alb
overview: A family adventure about a 12-year-old boy who embarks on a treasure hunt with his friends after discovering a mysterious letter addressed to his late mother.

title: The Shepherd
overview: Set in the desolate Nevada night, a young woman in labor flees an abusive past who has her escape hijacked by a mysterious stranger hiding an ominous threat in the back of her car.

title: Hanna
overview: USSR, during the Great Patriotic War. A Russian woman saves a German girl, Hannah, who, thanks to their friendship, learns to survive and maintain hope.

title: Magic Lamp
overview: Shy and sometimes naive schoolboy Sashka lives with his grandmother and confides his secrets to a smart speaker because he has no friends. But Sashka has a special power - faith in miracles, thanks to which he gets into a whirlpool of extraordinary events. In the company of a witty genie from a jug and a smart speaker that has come to life, Alisa, Sashka sets off on a dangerous journey across half the world to find his parents, who after a sandstorm in Uzbekistan ended up in a magical city, captive to Shah Zaman. Sashka and company will face the machinations of the evil sorcerer Yusuf, battles on flying carpets, hot air balloon trips, chases across endless steppes, crossing the desert and meeting people who are ready to help the boy find his family again.

title: All Forgotten Now
overview: A shocking act of terror carried out by ten stateless militants unfolds in a place no one ever imagined could become a hostage site. Over 100 lives are taken captive in exchange for three uncompromising demands.

title: The Myth of Maracuda 2: Sugar Age
The Legend of Zelda
overview: A live-action adaptation of Nintendo's Legend of Zelda video game series.

title: Monitor
overview: A social media moderator unleashes a deadly terror when she refuses to publish a cryptic video.
